prompt:
Scene:
A square color magazine advertisement page in the style of 1959 American kitchenware print ads. Full product-hero layout: appliance centered on a gradient studio backdrop, clear top headline banner area, bottom tagline area. Halftone grain, slight CMYK offset on edges, matte coated-paper feel.

Subject:
An imaginary atomic-age countertop dishwasher shaped like a clear acrylic glass dome on an ivory porcelain base trimmed with chrome and a single cadmium-red foot pedal. Inside the dome a rack of colorful mid-century dinnerware is bathed in arcing jets of bubbly water, frozen mid-spray. The dome is lit from inside with a warm amber light. A brass nameplate on the base and a small round analog timer dial are visible. Backdrop is a soft ivory-to-powder-pink gradient. Small stylized starburst motifs decorate top corners.

Important details:
Strict atomic-age palette: ivory, turquoise, cadmium red, bright yellow, powder pink, chrome. Dome must feel like imagined future dishwasher of 1959: transparent bubble, chrome trim, big red pedal, analog timer. Rendering must feel like printed illustration, not photo: halftone grain, flat highlights, slight sketch-style outline on chrome edges.

Use case:
Atomic Appliance Studies single study 3 of 5, independent product ad mockup.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no modern stainless steel dishwasher, no LCD display, no touchscreen, no photoreal depth-of-field, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.

description: Magazine-ad mockup of an imaginary atomic-age countertop dome dishwasher with visible mid-century dinnerware inside.
